ingredientSections.heading: Vegetarian Squash & Miso Ramen
items: 1 ½ Cups Red Kurri or Kabocha Squash, peeled, deseeded and cubed

methodSections.heading: Vegetarian Squash & Miso Ramen
steps: Soak the Kombu in two litres of water for three hours.
In a large saucepan cook onions, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft. Add the squash and cook for a few minutes. Season with salt.
Add kombu and the water the kombu has been soaking in and bring to boil, lower heat and simmer until squash is soft.
Remove from the heat and add the miso. Remove kombu and then blend until smooth.
Season with soy sauce and more salt if needed to taste.
Cook the ramen in boiling water for two minutes and drain.
Pour the squash sauce over the noodles, garnish with cress, sesame seeds, sesame oil and nori.
